## Cormano — G4 background stallion

Cormano is the light-cyan Earth pony seen hauling hay in Appleloosa. Look for his pale blue mane and tail, bright green eyes, **pink cowboy hat**, and **two-cherry cutie mark**. He is part of the *Friendship is Magic* television background cast, not a major speaking character. The [G4 stallion catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) identifies him and records both sightings.

**Name and voice:** “Cormano” is a community/catalog identification; I could not verify its origin or an official spoken, script, or merchandise naming. No dialogue or voice actor is reliably documented for **this** stallion. Similar-looking ponies such as Black Stone and Cherry Fizzy are separate background identifications, not established alter egos.

## Important moments

Cormano has no verified character-defining dialogue or decisions; these are his two recognizable on-screen background moments:

- **Hay-cart duty — “Over a Barrel” (S1E21).** He pulls hay in Appleloosa, helping give the Western settlement its busy, working-town atmosphere. [Full episode on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200198856/s01-e21-over-a-barrel) — **scene timestamp unavailable**.
- **Returning to the frontier — “The Last Roundup” (S2E14).** He is identified hauling hay again, making the pink-hatted stallion recognizable beyond his debut. [Full episode on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/en-gb/tv-shows/200198933/s02-e14-the-last-roundup) — **scene timestamp unavailable**.

There is no verified secret identity or transformation associated with him.
